information.description:
Militech Sharpshooters are best described as independent quasi-snipers that roam from position to position looking for targets of opportunity. While rarely deployed in security roles, they often work alongside ARS troopers or similar units on special ops.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Militech).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Just like Achilles, mythical, nearly invincible warrior of Ancient Greece, this Militech weapon is also unsurpassed in its class: the M-179 Achilles is truly the best electromagnetic precision rifle on the market. The Achilles features an ultra-long range alongside fierce power – meaning the bullets hit home just as hard, even at great distances. A sniper equipped with the Achilles can easily pierce through walls or armored vehicles. Now, the mythical Achilles had one fatal weakness. What about his namesake? Well, perhaps one flaw would be its complicated, difficult-to-use construction, not to mention its steep price point.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 9 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6).

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

The Omaha looks like your classic lead-spitter, but don't let appearances fool you. This gem from Militech conceals its powerful electromag rail system which launches solid-metal projectiles instead of firing ordinary pistol rounds. With each pull of the trigger, the Omaha quietly slings out three projectiles with tremendous force behind them. It's no wonder it’s commonly found in the holsters of corpos at the high end of the food chain.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 9 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: After being charged, this weapon’s Tech Rebuild remains so until the end of a Turn in which it was fired. While charged, this weapon remains ROF 2, expends 3 rounds in a burst with every Attack, and whenever it would ablate armor, ablates 1 additional SP. Incompatible with Pistol Auto Sear.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
